ios.desc:
Guided breathing exercises for stress, anxiety, and sleep. 8 built-in patterns, custom sessions, streak tracking, widgets, and Apple Health sync. All free. No account needed.

8 RESEARCH-BACKED BREATHING PATTERNS

Each pattern is proven to help and designed for a different moment in your day:

• Morning Boost (4-2-2): An energizing, inhale-focused pattern to wake up with clarity
• Quick Calm (4-6): A balanced breath with a longer exhale to settle quickly between meetings
• Coherent 5-5: Five counts in, five counts out, the classic coherent breathing rhythm for everyday balance
• Deep Focus (5-5-5-5): Slow cycles with extended holds for deep concentration
• Box Breathing (4-4-4-4): The steady four-count square for staying composed under pressure
• Sleep Prep (4-4-8): A long exhale to slow your heart rate before bed
• 4-7-8: The classic wind-down technique for quieting a racing mind
• Extended Exhale (4-8): A gentle 1:2 ratio with no holds, the easiest way into sleep breathing

You can also create your own pattern with per-phase controls for inhale, hold, exhale, and hold out.

WHAT YOU GET FOR FREE

Every breathing pattern. Every session length. Streak tracking. Apple Health sync. Haptic feedback. No limits, no trial, no account required.

Premium adds analytics, data export, saved custom patterns, and extra haptic styles for people who want to go deeper. More on that below.

FEATURES

• Visual animations and haptic cues guide each breath. You can close your eyes and follow the vibrations alone.
• A 7-day guided journey introduces each pattern with daily goals so you can build a consistent habit in your first week.
• Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets keep your streak in sight, with a gentle glow until you've breathed today.
• Automatic session logging, streaks, and milestones help you see your progress over time.
• Mindful minutes sync to Apple Health automatically.
• Full VoiceOver support with phase announcements and accessibility hints on every control.
• Works offline. No internet needed, ever.
• Dark, distraction-free interface. Screen stays awake during sessions.

PREMIUM (OPTIONAL)

Upgrade to Premium for:
• Detailed progress charts and trends
• Activity calendar heat map
• CSV and PDF data export
• Advanced session metrics
• Save and name up to 20 of your own breathing patterns
• Extra haptic styles that follow your breath

PRIVACY

Your sessions stay on your device. No accounts. No tracking. No ads. The only thing Orris ever sends is feedback you

quotes.text:
I'm working on building Orris (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/orris-breathing-exercises/id6749783699): a breathing app for iOS. Built it because I wanted something simple for winding down before sleep and everything I tried was either bloated with content I didn't want or locked basic features behind a paywall.

It does guided breathing sessions with variable phase durations (4-7-8, box breathing, etc), streak tracking, and HealthKit integration. It's all based on SwiftUI, Swift 6, with no backend. Currently exploring adding ambient soundscapes for sleep sessions.

Solo project, been working on it for a few months on the side. Also been a fun journey back into iOS after almost 10 years away!
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What Are You Working On? (April 2026)
